GRADE 2 ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — TERM 2 EXAM

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
Time: 40 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Word reading in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Word reading using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Word reading completely.
   C. Word reading is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Word reading.

2. About Word reading when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Word reading at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Word reading completely.
   C. Word reading is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Word reading.

3. About Word reading while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. Word reading helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Word reading completely.
   C. Word reading is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Word reading.

5. About Connected text reading and fluency in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?

   B. Learners should ignore Connected text reading and fluency completely.
   C. Connected text reading and fluency is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Connected text reading and fluency.

   D. There is no need to practise Connected text reading and fluency.

7. About Connected text reading and fluency while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. Connected text reading and fluency helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Connected text reading and fluency completely.
   C. Connected text reading and fluency is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Connected text reading and fluency.

9. About Comprehension in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Comprehension using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Comprehension completely.
   C. Comprehension is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Comprehension.

10. About Comprehension when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Comprehension at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Comprehension completely.
   C. Comprehension is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Comprehension.

11. About Comprehension while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. Comprehension helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Comprehension completely.
   C. Comprehension is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Comprehension.

13. About Pre- Writing in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Pre- Writing using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Pre- Writing completely.
   C. Pre- Writing is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Pre- Writing.

14. About Pre- Writing when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Pre- Writing at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Pre- Writing completely.
   C. Pre- Writing is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Pre- Writing.

15. About Pre- Writing while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. Pre- Writing helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Pre- Writing completely.
   C. Pre- Writing is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Pre- Writing.

17. About Handwriting in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Handwriting using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Handwriting completely.
   C. Handwriting is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Handwriting.

18. About Handwriting when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Handwriting at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Handwriting completely.
   C. Handwriting is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Handwriting.

19. About Handwriting while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. Handwriting helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Handwriting completely.
   C. Handwriting is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Handwriting.
